title: Table of operating modes
body_md:
The rotary switch has sixteen positions. The source assigns them the following properties:

| Position | Call triggers status report | Call switches the alarm system | Interval of automatic status reports | Voltages contained | Geofencing via pin 3 | Manual alarm via pin 3 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | yes | – | – | – | – | – |
| 1 | yes | – | – | U1, U2 | – | – |
| 2 | – | yes | – | – | – | – |
| 3 | – | yes | – | U1, U2 | – | – |
| 4 | yes | – | 15 minutes | U1 to U5 | – | – |
| 5 | yes | – | 60 minutes | U1 to U5 | – | – |
| 6 | yes | – | 6 hours | U1 to U5 | – | – |
| 7 | yes | – | 24 hours | U1 to U5 | – | – |
| 8 | yes | – | – | – | above 6 V on, below 5 V off | – |
| 9 | yes | – | – | U1 to U5 | – | – |
| A | yes | – | – | – | – | yes |
| B | yes | – | – | – | above 6 V off, below 5 V on | – |
| C | yes | – | 90 seconds, once voltage is applied and the device is searching for the GPS signal | – | – | – |
| D | yes | – | 8 minutes, once voltage is applied and the device is searching for the GPS signal | – | – | – |
| E | Deleting the destination numbers | | | | | |
| F | GPS diagnosis | | | | | |

Between 5 V and 6 V the source makes no statement for positions 8 and B.

change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 10: all sixteen rows and eleven columns were compared cell by cell and match, including the intervals, the voltage thresholds and the assignment of the measurement inputs. Row D reads 8 minutes in both versions; the factor-60 contradiction of the generation up to SN-044 (DSC-066) does not recur here, and no value is carried across. The English wording of row D is the sounder one: the German cell duplicates the product name and omits a conjunction (DSC-087). The gap between 5 V and 6 V exists in both versions.
